item.title: Re: +1, of course, but...
item.content:encoded:
You could probably put that toilet paper in one of the safes to keep it safe, but whether putting it in the Safe safe would keep it Safe too, or just keep it safe in the Safe safe (while not technically being Safe), it's hard to say.

It'd save space to put it in a safe (either the Safe safe or one of the un-Safe safes), and you could probably ensure further safety by shooting it into outer space. So, if you placed it in a safe (either the Safe safe or an un-Safe safe), then placed the safe (whether Safe or not Safe) in outer space, its place in the safe and the safe's place in space would save space in the place where the toilet paper was originally placed.

This might placate the toilet paper too, possibly making it Safe as well as safe! Now it's placated and Safe (and safe) placed in a safe (either Safe or not safe) that's placed in a safe place (outer space), saving space in the space where it used to be placed!
